name: Stride Minimum Baseline Security Standard
source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 and CIS Amazon Linux 2 Benchmark
note: accepted=false marks a CIS control the firm reviewed and chose not to adopt. It is still checked in the initial assessment but is not enforced or drift-monitored.

controls.title: MFA is enabled for the root user
controls.recommendation: Sign in as root and register an MFA device. This cannot be automated.
controls.finding: The root user has no MFA device

controls.title: IAM password policy requires a minimum length of 14
controls.recommendation: Set the account password policy minimum length to 14 or more.
controls.finding: The password policy allows passwords as short as {actual} characters; the baseline requires 14

controls.title: IAM password policy prevents reuse of the last 24 passwords
controls.recommendation: Set password reuse prevention to 24.
controls.finding: The password policy remembers only {actual} previous passwords; the baseline requires 24

controls.title: MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
controls.recommendation: Have the user register an MFA device, or remove their console password.
controls.finding: This user can sign in to the console without MFA

controls.title: Access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
controls.recommendation: Create a new access key, update the applications that use it, then deactivate the old key.
controls.finding: This user's access key is {actual} days old; the limit is 90

controls.title: No IAM user has a full administrator policy attached directly
controls.recommendation: Detach AdministratorAccess and grant only the permissions the user needs, through a group or role.
controls.finding: This user has the full administrator policy attached directly

controls.exclusion_reason: A virtual MFA device on root is accepted for a firm of this size; hardware tokens are not issued.
controls.title: Hardware MFA is enabled for the root user
controls.recommendation: Register a hardware MFA device for the root user.
controls.finding: The root user is not protected by a hardware MFA device

controls.title: S3 buckets block public access
controls.recommendation: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings for the bucket.
controls.finding: Block Public Access is off, so the bucket can be made public

controls.title: S3 bucket policy denies requests that do not use HTTPS
controls.recommendation: Add a bucket policy statement that denies requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.
controls.finding: The bucket accepts unencrypted (HTTP) requests

controls.title: S3 bucket versioning is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable versioning on the bucket.
controls.finding: Versioning is off, so deleted or overwritten objects cannot be recovered

controls.title: EBS encryption by default is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption by default in the region.
controls.finding: New disks are not encrypted by default

controls.title: EBS volumes attached to servers are encrypted
controls.recommendation: Snapshot the volume, copy the snapshot with encryption, and replace the volume in a downtime window.
controls.finding: The server has a disk that is not encrypted

controls.exclusion_reason: MFA delete needs the root user for every change and is judged impractical; versioning is enforced instead.
controls.title: MFA delete is enabled on S3 buckets
controls.recommendation: Enable MFA delete using the root user's credentials.
controls.finding: MFA delete is off

controls.title: No security group allows SSH (port 22) from the internet
controls.recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule for port 22 and use Systems Manager Session Manager or a restricted source range.

controls.title: No security group allows RDP (port 3389) from the internet
controls.recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule for port 3389.

controls.title: The default security group of every VPC restricts all traffic
controls.recommendation: Remove all rules from the default security group and move resources to purpose-built groups.
controls.finding: The default security group still has rules

controls.title: No security group allows database ports (3306, 5432) from the internet
controls.recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule and allow the database port only from the application tier.

controls.title: CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
controls.recommendation: Make the trail a multi-region trail.
controls.finding: The audit trail only covers one region

controls.title: CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable log file validation on the trail.
controls.finding: Log file validation is off, so tampering with audit logs would go unnoticed

controls.title: AWS Config recording is enabled
controls.recommendation: Start the AWS Config configuration recorder.
controls.finding: AWS Config recording is stopped

controls.title: VPC flow logging is enabled
controls.recommendation: Create a flow log for the VPC that captures rejected traffic at minimum.
controls.finding: Network flow logging is off

controls.title: S3 server access logging is enabled on buckets
controls.recommendation: Enable server access logging to the central log bucket.
controls.finding: Access to the bucket is not being logged

controls.title: EC2 instances require IMDSv2
controls.recommendation: Set the instance metadata option HttpTokens to required.
controls.finding: The server still accepts the older, weaker metadata service (IMDSv1)

controls.title: EC2 instances are managed by Systems Manager
controls.recommendation: Attach an instance profile with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and confirm the SSM agent is running.
controls.finding: The server is not managed by Systems Manager, so it cannot be patched automatically

controls.title: SSH root login is disabled
controls.recommendation: Set PermitRootLogin no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.
controls.finding: Root can log in over SSH

controls.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
controls.recommendation: Set PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.
controls.finding: SSH accepts passwords instead of keys only
